scripts.build: find dist -name .DS_Store -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/Videolar && cp index.html 404.html styles.css script.js dist/ && cp -R assets dist/assets && find Videolar -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -name 'Video #1.mp4' ! -name 'Video #4.mp4' ! -name 'Video #6.mp4' ! -name 'Video #7.mp4' ! -name 'Video #9.mp4' -exec cp {} dist/Videolar/ \; && cp -R Fotoğraflar dist/Fotoğraflar && cp -R Logolar dist/Logolar && cp -R Bağlantılar dist/Bağlantılar && find dist -name .DS_Store -delete
